# Astera Loader plugin header

`al_plugin.h`: the Astera Loader plugin API 1.8, copied unchanged from the
Astera Loader repository (`include/al/al_plugin.h`), version 0.2.0 in
progress: the header as of commit `aed4647747142fba3fa92f88cc7fab3769847374`
(al.patch, the plugin guide, the ABI review of API 1.8), unchanged at
`035ef331e61fcf7fedc12b4b1777a8301a5f3161` (the dev build in MO2 on
2026-10-12). SHA-256 of the copy (CRLF line endings, as in AL's working
tree): `e2e027280ad12834fd2cf00d709eba24aa85c1cf5a60443efb6380bfeb72ebd7`.
MIT licence (`LICENSE`, Astera Loader project).

Before: API 1.7, release tag `v0.1.0`, commit
`ba04bd1eb19dd067651c7866d6a85d1c77dc477e`.

Update by copying the newer header and recording the tag and commit here
(AL tags `v0.2.0-dev.N` after the in-game run with CMFM, then `v0.2.0`).
